name: wiki-markdown
description: Markdown-backed AI-native durable-context provider with proactive recall, approval-gated capture proposals, and a dedicated initialization skill for agent policy scaffolding.

interface.shortDescription: Manage an AI-native project wiki backed by markdown files.
interface.longDescription: Provides a cross-plugin durable-context contract over a markdown-backed wiki under wiki/: proactively recalls relevant intent, decisions, lessons, and current state; scaffolds a best-effort operating policy that proposes genuine durable candidates without displacing the primary answer; and writes only with configured authority. Agent-facing initialization composes deterministic vault setup with an idempotent auto-loaded policy block in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, while raw CLI init remains vault-only.
defaultPrompt: Use $wiki-markdown:wiki proactively when substantive work or discussion could depend on prior intent, decisions, lessons, or current state; recall the relevant scope once and reuse it.

At a semantic milestone or closeout, finish the primary answer first, audit existing context internally, and append one optional grouped capture question at the bottom of the same final answer only when durable candidates exist; otherwise stay silent. Write only after configured authority is satisfied.
For a concrete runtime defect, inspect code and runtime evidence first instead of repeatedly recalling the wiki.
Use $wiki-markdown:init to initialize the vault and install the auto-loaded policy block while preserving all content outside its managed markers.
Use $wiki-markdown:wiki to capture this decision and refresh indexes.
Use $wiki-markdown:agent-policy to scaffold Claude/Codex operating policy files directly.
